title: The Moonpear Price Trick
story: At the Nightfruit Market, Halverstock the Orchard Factor has locked the villagers' moonpear crop in a glass vault and will only release it for the 'honest' price. He posts a sign: 42 silver acorns per crate, then adds a 20% night-harvest surcharge, then gives a 25% loyalty discount on that new total. Mr 6 tilts his helmet and starts figuring.
question: After the 20% surcharge and then the 25% discount, how many silver acorns does one crate cost?
praise: Adding the surcharge first was exactly the right order — the one missing step was taking 75% of the NEW price, not of the original 42.
hint: Do the two changes in order: raise 42 by 20% first, then take 75% of that result.
victory: Mr 6 read the price aloud to the whole market, and Halverstock's glass vault popped open from sheer embarrassment, spilling moonpears into every waiting basket.
imagePrompt: A night market lit by pale lantern-moons where a lanky top-hatted factor guards a glass vault of glowing pears while a numeral-six knight chalks a price calculation on a market slate before cheering villagers.
